_note: Sign-in list for the board. Passwords are never stored: each entry keeps a random salt and a PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA256 derivation of the password at 210000 iterations, which is what the browser recomputes to check a sign-in. READ THIS BEFORE RELYING ON IT: this file is served to the browser, because the board is a static site. The gate keeps the dashboard from opening for someone who lands on the URL, and it is not a security boundary - /data/dashboard-data.json and the other JSON files can still be fetched directly by anyone who has the link, sign-in or not. Cloudflare Access is the control that actually protects them. See docs/access.md.
